triage.kind_span: The Fund is issuing transferable subscription Rights to its Common Shareholders of record as of May 25, 2021

subject_names.span: Clough Global Equity Fund Rights for 5,512,845 Shares Subscription Rights to Purchase Common Shares

subject_tickers.span: The Fund’s common shares are traded on the NYSE American LLC under the symbol “GLQ”.

security_class.span: Subscription Rights to Purchase Common Shares

rights_per_share.span: Record Date Shareholders will receive one Right for each common share held on the Record Date.

rights_per_new_share.span: For every three Rights held, you are entitled to purchase one new common share of the Fund.

price_reference.span: a formula equal to 85% of the reported net asset value or 95% of the market price per common share, whichever is higher on the Expiration Date

price_floor_pct_nav.span: a formula equal to 85% of the reported net asset value or 95% of the market price per common share, whichever is higher on the Expiration Date

record_date.span: The Fund is issuing transferable subscription Rights to its Common Shareholders of record as of May 25, 2021 (the “Record Date”

expiration_date.span: The Offer will expire at 5:00 p.m., Eastern Time, on June 22, 2021, unless the Offer is extended as described in this Prospectus

transferable.span: The Rights are transferable and will be admitted for trading on the NYSE American under the symbol “GLQ RT” during the course of the Offer.

over_subscription.span: Record Date Shareholders who fully exercise their Rights may also, in certain circumstances, purchase additional common shares pursuant to an Over-Subscription Privilege.

max_new_shares.span: in an aggregate amount of approximately 5,512,845 common shares (the “Offer”)

notes: Prospectus supplement dated 2021-05-21. Subscription price is the higher of 85% of NAV or 95% of the five-day average market price on the expiration date; two percents against two references, so price_pct is null. 85% of NAV is entered as price_floor_pct_nav because it acts as a floor under the higher-of formula (interpretation). Estimated subscription price $14.41. Rights rounded up to multiples of three; over-subscription may be eliminated by the Board in its discretion. Board may extend the expiration; no later date is stated.
